mapper.sql: id, session_id, role, content, metadata, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, role, content, metadata) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{metadata}::jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

WITH run_trigger AS ( SELECT created_at FROM chat_message WHERE id = #{triggerId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} ) SELECT FROM ( SELECT FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND created_at <= (SELECT created_at FROM run_trigger) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) older UNION ALL SELECT FROM ( SELECT FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND role <> 'user' AND created_at > (SELECT created_at FROM run_trigger) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{laterLimit} ) later ORDER BY created_at ASC
